audit.whatIsWrong: Multiple fields (whys[1],whys[2],spikes[0].text, early, mid, wants.you[0], wants.you[1], wants.foe[1]) call Renata's root 'E Loyalty Program', but per the kit her E (Loyalty Program) shields/slows via chemtech missiles — the root is her Q, Handshake. This mislabels the ability that gates Rakan's engage.
audit.why: Telling a reader to engage when 'her E is down' instead of 'her Q is down' points them at the wrong cooldown, which is the entire point of the advice.
audit.corrected: Replace every 'E (Loyalty Program)' / 'E Loyalty Program' root reference with 'Q (Handshake)' / 'Q Handshake', matching the kit.
sources: enemyKit.abilities Q (hardCC, root text) vs E (slow+shield text)

audit.why: Rakan wins every stage per packet.levelChart and content win[]/whys[] — mobility and ranged knockup beat her immobile, telegraphed kit throughout.

audit.whatIsWrong: All 7 phases[N].side were the placeholder 'Skill' while win[0..6] already all say Rakan, and generic why text didn't ground the actual advantage.

audit.corrected: Set all 7 sides to 'Rakan' and rewrite the whys using the corrected Q/Handshake reference.

edits.after: Commit on Hostile Takeover’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Make her flinch first.

edits.before: - Renata Glasc Hostile Takeover: matchup-defining — The berserk wave turns your team on itself — never group in a line against it. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Battle Dance banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Hostile Takeover is 150/130/110s — the berserk wave turns your team on itself, never group in a line against it. - Handshake (Q) is a flat 16s root; engage the moment it's down. - Keep E Battle Dance banked for their best play.

edits.before: Q the pair for the heal, W the window, E home — the trade paid twice and answered once.
edits.after: Handshake (Q) is on a 16s cooldown — engage the instant it whiffs or lands on someone else.

edits.before: Entrancing into a banked disengage — the bird that flies into tornadoes writes the highlight for the other team.

edits.after: At level 2 your knockup beats her slow, dodgeable Q Handshake root.

edits.before: You spike at 2: your W-Q knockup gives instant lane pressure while Renata's E (Loyalty Program) is a slow, dodgeable long-range root. Engage when her E is on cooldown and she has no self-peel.
edits.after: You spike at 2: your W-Q knockup gives instant lane pressure while Renata's Q (Handshake) is a slow, dodgeable long-range root. Engage when her Q is on cooldown and she has no self-peel.

edits.before: You own levels 1-2. Renata is a completely immobile enchanter whose only early lockdown is E Loyalty Program — a slow-traveling, dodgeable long-range root — so your W-Q knockup gives you instant pressure she can't match. Engage when her E is down and she has no escape. Keep your ADC forward for free poke, and ward her flanks since a jungler pairing with her E root is her only real kill setup at this stage.
edits.after: You own levels 1-2. Renata is a completely immobile enchanter whose only early lockdown is Q Handshake — a slow-traveling, dodgeable long-range root — so your W-Q knockup gives you instant pressure she can't match. Engage when her Q is down and she has no escape. Keep your ADC forward for free poke, and ward her flanks since a jungler pairing with her Q root is her only real kill setup at this stage.

edits.before: Through 3-6 you dictate the lane on mobility. Renata has no dash and relies on landing E from range, so bait the root, let it whiff, then W in and land your knockup on the cooldown window. Your level-6 Grand Entrance out-tempos her Hostile Takeover, which needs your team already clustered to matter — charm her out of position before she can angle her ult. Play around her E timer and she has no answer to your in-and-out.
edits.after: Through 3-6 you dictate the lane on mobility. Renata has no dash and relies on landing Q from range, so bait the root, let it whiff, then W in and land your knockup on the cooldown window. Your level-6 Grand Entrance out-tempos her Hostile Takeover, which needs your team already clustered to matter — charm her out of position before she can angle her ult. Play around her Q timer and she has no answer to your in-and-out.
